steps.meaning: The ethics committee meets on 12 March 2026 at 2:00 PM America/New_York to consider the compassionate-use request.
steps.name: meeting_occurs

steps.meaning: Dr. Osei puts the motion to approve the compassionate-use request to a vote, which takes about five minutes.
steps.name: chair_puts_motion

steps.meaning: Pharmacist Lindqvist prepares and circulates a safety review incorporating the updated trial data to committee members via hospital email.
steps.name: safety_review_circulated

steps.meaning: The manufacturer releases updated trial safety data on 10 March 2026 at 8:00 AM America/New_York.
steps.name: manufacturer_releases_data

steps.meaning: Dr. Osei votes to approve the request, which she will only do if a current safety review is available and favorable.
steps.name: osei_votes_approve

steps.meaning: Dr. Patel votes to approve the request, which he consistently does when a safety review is available and favorable.
steps.name: patel_votes_approve

steps.meaning: Sister Doyle votes to approve the request, which she does when a documented safety assessment has been provided to her.
steps.name: doyle_votes_approve

steps.meaning: Sister Doyle receives the safety review before the meeting; she is off-site on retreat from 10 to 12 March and cannot receive email, but she attends the meeting in person and may receive a printed copy or be briefed at the meeting.
steps.name: doyle_receives_review
steps.uncertainty: It is uncertain how Doyle receives the review given her retreat; she may receive it at the meeting.
